title: Australian Vegetable Casserole
description: A hearty and comforting casserole filled with the flavors of Australia, perfect for a weeknight dinner. This recipe combines the richness of old-fashioned vegetables with the fresh taste of Australian produce.
instructions: In a large pot, heat the oil over medium heat. Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped carrots, sliced zucchini, sliced eggplant, and chopped potatoes to the pot. Cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Stir in the tomato paste and cook for 1 minute.
Add the beef broth to the pot and bring to a boil.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 15 minutes, or until the top is golden brown.
